## Background

I am a Principal Scientist at Earth Sciences New Zealand. My work focuses on 
subseasonal to seasonal (S2S) climate forecasting and building robust 
data pipelines for environmental analytics.

## Research Interests
* Subseasonal to Seasonal (S2S) Forecasting
* Machine Learning in Climate Science
* Python for Geospatial Data Analysis
